description: Get a staff member's profile by AniList staff ID: name, image, occupations, description, and the anime/manga they hold production credits on (`staffMedia`, most popular first, with their `staffRole` — e.g. Director, Character Design, Theme Song Performance — in each). Use search_staff first to resolve a name to its ID. Voice-acting roles are NOT part of `staffMedia` (confirmed live: Kana Hanazawa's lists only her theme/insert song credits) — for a voice actor, pass `credits: "voice"` to get `characterMedia` instead: each title with the character(s) voiced and their `characterRole`. Either list is paginated (`page`/`perPage`, max 25) — check its `pageInfo.hasNextPage` before treating it as the full list. Narrow it with `onList`, or `type` (anime or manga only; production credits only).

credits.description: Which filmography to return: "production" (`staffMedia` — director, writer, theme song, …) or "voice" (`characterMedia` — voice-acting roles). One per call.

onList.description: [Requires login] Restrict the filmography to (true) or exclude (false) titles already on the authenticated user's own list. Omit to ignore list status entirely. Errors if not logged in (AniList would otherwise silently ignore it and return the unfiltered filmography).

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 25, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

type.description: Only return anime (ANIME) or only manga (MANGA) in `staffMedia` — filtered by AniList before pagination, so pages stay full. Omit for both.
